_doc: Bundled fixes to cache/data/npcs/combat/*.npc.json, applied by BundledNpcCombatPatches before NPCCDLoader indexes the definitions. Keys: id, name (cache name check), merge (deep-merged into the definition), copyFrom/onlyIfAbsent. Animation ids are build-241 seqs (RuneLite gameval AnimationID names in _why). Area: bosses (BOSS-02/03/04/08/09/10/11/13, PVP-27).
